values.value: Under GDPR Article 37 a DPO is required when your core activities involve large-scale processing of special-category data or large-scale monitoring. Many charities process special-category data (health, religion, children). Decide, document and name the person.
A DPO is named, or there is a documented reason why one isn't required and a named GDPR/AVG lead.
Have you appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO)? If a DPO isn't legally required, have you documented why and named the person who handles GDPR/AVG instead?

When is a DPO legally required (GDPR Advisor)|https://www.gdpr-advisor.com/when-is-a-dpo-legally-required-understanding-the-gdpr-criteria/ GDPR Article 37 - Designation of the DPO|https://gdpr-info.eu/art-37-gdpr/
